findings.label: Backend endpoint strategy mismatch
findings.description: Both approveProfile() and rejectProfile() use dual-endpoint fallback (new /status then legacy /approve/decline). If backend only implements one pattern, requests will silently fail. Requires backend team confirmation of which endpoint is authoritative.

findings.label: GSI re-initialization timing gap
findings.description: Logout calls cancel() and clears state, but button re-render depends on [user, token] effect. If user navigates away before React completes the effect, GSI cleanup may be incomplete.

findings.label: Token refresh concurrency under load
findings.description: Debounce pattern (5s window) may cause multiple simultaneous API calls to skip refresh if all see lastRefreshTime as stale. Singleton promise helps but doesn't handle expiry edge case where token expires between check and first API call in a batch.

findings.label: API response shape assumptions
findings.description: getMyCases(), getAllCases(), and similar methods check 4+ response shape variants. If backend returns unexpected structure, caller gets empty array silently instead of error, making issues hard to diagnose.

findings.label: Missing case ownership validation
findings.description: getCaseDetails() and updateCase() don't verify the authenticated user owns the case. Backend should enforce this, but frontend should not expose case IDs that allow direct enumeration attacks.

findings.label: Lead form assessment response not validated
findings.description: After creating immigration assessment via lead form, response parsing assumes result.data?.id exists. If API changes shape, client receives empty caseId and sees success message.
